verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ. لِدَاوُدَ هُوَذَا مَا أَحْسَنَ وَمَا أَجْمَلَ أَنْ يَسْكُنَ ٱلْإِخْوَةُ مَعًا!
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant [it is] for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

verses.ar: مِثْلُ ٱلدُّهْنِ ٱلطَّيِّبِ عَلَى ٱلرَّأْسِ، ٱلنَّازِلِ عَلَى ٱللِّحْيَةِ، لِحْيَةِ هَارُونَ، ٱلنَّازِلِ إِلَى طَرَفِ ثِيَابِهِ.
verses.kjv: [It is] like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, [even] Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.web: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

verses.ar: مِثْلُ نَدَى حَرْمُونَ ٱلنَّازِلِ عَلَى جَبَلِ صِهْيَوْنَ. لِأَنَّهُ هُنَاكَ أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِٱلْبَرَكَةِ، حَيَاةٍ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: As the dew of Hermon, [and as the dew] that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, [even] life for evermore.
verses.web: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
